title: aidd doctor --json
description: What `aidd doctor --json` prints: each check of the repository's wiring, whether any failed, and a finding for each check that failed or warned.

schema_version.description: The version of this output's shape. A new key keeps it; a renamed, removed, or retyped key bumps it.

passed.description: True when no check failed: the exit code is 0. A warning never fails.

checks.description: Each check, in the order the text output prints them.

result.description: ok, warn (worth fixing), fail (the exit code is 1), or info (never a finding).

message.description: What the check found, with the next step when it is not ok.

findings.description: One finding for each check that failed or warned, in the order of `checks`, with the message the check gives. A check that passed or only informs is no finding.
